brain/app.py.purpose: FastAPI application with all REST API endpoints
brain/app.py.notes: Main API surface, coordinates all subsystems

brain/llm.py.purpose: LLM client wrapper for Ollama, handles streaming generation
brain/llm.py.notes: Single source of truth for LLM communication, streaming SSE responses

brain/_legacy_prompt_builder.py.purpose: LEGACY: Backward-compatible build_prompt() shim, uses new modular components internally
brain/_legacy_prompt_builder.py.notes: Migration shim - maintains old API while using new architecture. Will be removed after full migration.

brain/prompt_builder/__init__.py.purpose: Modular prompt building system - exports components and legacy build_prompt()
brain/prompt_builder/__init__.py.notes: New modular architecture replaces old monolithic prompt_builder.py

brain/prompt_builder/context_retriever.p.purpose: Retrieves context from RAG store and configuration
brain/prompt_builder/context_retriever.p.notes: Pure retrieval logic, no formatting. Tested with 14 tests.

brain/prompt_builder/section_builder.py.purpose: Formats RAG context into structured prompt sections
brain/prompt_builder/section_builder.py.notes: Pure formatting logic, no retrieval. Tested with 14 tests.

brain/prompt_builder/prompt_assembler.py.purpose: Orchestrates prompt building - coordinates ContextRetriever, SectionBuilder, and specialists
brain/prompt_builder/prompt_assembler.py.notes: Main orchestrator, handles section ordering and specialist coordination. Tested with 10 tests.

brain/rag_store.py.purpose: Vector database interface for semantic search over memories

brain/schemas.py.purpose: All Pydantic models for API contracts and data validation
brain/schemas.py.notes: Self-documenting via /v1/schema endpoint, single source of truth for types

brain/config.py.notes: All environment variables defined here, singleton pattern

brain/token_monitor.py.purpose: Track and monitor token usage by component for context optimization (v2.0)
brain/token_monitor.py.notes: Phase 1 v2.0 feature - provides visibility into token usage patterns before optimization. Uses tiktoken for accurate counting.

brain/specialists/protocol.py.purpose: Base protocol for specialist plugins, MCP-inspired architecture
brain/specialists/protocol.py.notes: Protocol-based design for extensibility, priority controls context order

brain/specialists/ocr_specialist.py.purpose: Extract text from uploaded images using Tesseract OCR
brain/specialists/ocr_specialist.py.notes: Auto-activated on image uploads, results injected early in prompt

brain/specialists/listenbrainz_specialis.purpose: Inject music context from ListenBrainz API for currently playing or recent tracks
brain/specialists/listenbrainz_specialis.notes: Provides ListenBrainz scrobbling data and recently played tracks

brain/specialists/docs_specialist.py.purpose: Search and retrieve Ada's own Sphinx documentation for self-reference
brain/specialists/docs_specialist.py.notes: Meta-capability: Ada can read her own documentation. Searches docs/_build/html

brain/specialists/web_search_specialist..purpose: Perform web searches when LLM requests external information
brain/specialists/web_search_specialist..notes: Bidirectional specialist, LLM can request searches mid-generation

brain/specialists/wiki_specialist.py.purpose: Look up information from MediaWiki-based wikis (Wikipedia, Fandom)
brain/specialists/wiki_specialist.py.notes: Bidirectional specialist, supports Wikipedia and Object Show fandom wikis with smart search

brain/specialists/bidirectional.py.purpose: Enables LLM to invoke specialists mid-response using XML tags
brain/specialists/bidirectional.py.notes: Powers tool-use pattern, LLM outputs XML tags to trigger specialists

brain/notices.py.purpose: System notification manager for alerts and status messages
brain/notices.py.notes: Persistent JSON storage, notices injected into prompts with high priority

brain/ocr.py.purpose: Tesseract OCR integration for image text extraction

brain/media.py.purpose: File upload handling and video frame extraction

brain/wsgi.py.purpose: Gunicorn WSGI entrypoint for production deployment

frontend/public/app.js.purpose: Browser client for SSE streaming, handles EventSource
frontend/public/app.js.notes: Pure JavaScript, no frameworks, EventSource for SSE

scripts/consolidate_memories.py.purpose: Nightly memory summarization, reduces vector DB size
scripts/consolidate_memories.py.notes: Runs via cron in Docker Compose, summarizes old conversation turns

scripts/version.sh.purpose: Version management automation with Semantic Versioning and Conventional Commits
scripts/version.sh.notes: Analyzes commit history to suggest version bumps, automates version file updates and git tagging

scripts/changelog.sh.purpose: Generate formatted changelogs from Conventional Commits
scripts/changelog.sh.notes: Parses git history, groups commits by type (feat/fix/docs), outputs markdown changelog

scripts/validate-commit.sh.purpose: Validate commit messages follow Conventional Commits format
scripts/validate-commit.sh.notes: Can be installed as git commit-msg hook, enforces structured commit messages

matrix-bridge/bridge.py.purpose: Matrix bot main loop, connects Matrix rooms to Ada's brain
matrix-bridge/bridge.py.notes: Main Matrix bridge service, uses matrix-nio AsyncClient. Non-streaming approach with reaction-based status: 🧠 while processing, ✅ on success, ❌ on error. Filters old messages by timestamp.

matrix-bridge/config.py.notes: Bot identity, behavior, privacy settings, Matrix connection params

matrix-bridge/identity.py.purpose: Bot transparency and ethical presentation helpers
matrix-bridge/identity.py.notes: Ensures Ada is clearly identified as AI bot with opt-out instructions

matrix-bridge/ada_client.py.purpose: HTTP client for Ada's brain API with clean non-streaming interface
matrix-bridge/ada_client.py.notes: chat() method internally uses streaming but returns complete text - JSON parsing abstracted away from bridge logic

matrix-bridge/message_handler.py.purpose: Message processing, context management, command parsing
matrix-bridge/message_handler.py.notes: Per-room context storage, privacy opt-out, activation logic

adapters/cli/ada_cli/client.py.purpose: Reference implementation HTTP client for Ada's brain API
adapters/cli/ada_cli/client.py.notes: Simplest adapter implementation, demonstrates both streaming and non-streaming patterns. Will become foundation for shared ada-client library in Phase 2.

adapters/cli/ada_cli/cli.py.purpose: Interactive REPL and one-shot CLI interface
adapters/cli/ada_cli/cli.py.notes: Demonstrates CLI patterns: REPL mode with commands, one-shot queries, JSON output for scripting

frontend/public/app.js.purpose: Web UI adapter - browser-based EventSource client
frontend/public/app.js.notes: EventSource (SSE) client for streaming responses, proxied through nginx to /api/* endpoints
